$comment: Social cards for `npm run visuals` (scripts/visuals.mjs -> cards()). Each entry is rendered through the design system's visuals/card.html for every format (thumb, og, square, story) and theme (paper, night) into public/visuals/<id>/card-<format>-<theme>.png. The symbol and the image are derived, not stored here: `symbolFor(id)` in src/ui/glyphs.ts supplies the mark (custom glyphs for voxmpe and yousuckatdrums, shared with the live map; a Lucide icon for the rest, shared with the welcome page's item marks), and the theme-matched thumb shot in public/visuals/<id>/ (when one exists, the same way writeIndex() finds a project's `thumb`) supplies the image.
